s.da: Paruzzaro, località San Eufemia, bivio NOAVA3-NOAVA1-NOAVA2

s.nota: Path eroded by water, practically not signposted, sections invaded by vegetation. At the beginning of the climb you pass as if you were in the bed of a small stream with rocky jumps. The forest tracks are distorted and transformed into a bad path
